notes.GET /api/external/monitoring/requests/de: For type=assistant, requestId is the execution ID. prompt, inputText and completed outputText are limited to 20,000 characters each; media arrays are empty.
notes.GET /api/external/monitoring/overview: Covers image, video, audio and AI assistant requests. Service and reprocessing queues are excluded.
notes.GET /api/external/monitoring/requests: Includes the account's web and API generation requests.
notes.GET /api/external/generations/{requestId: Use the same account and API key that submitted the job.
notes.GET /api/external/history: Includes the account's web and API image, video, audio and AI assistant jobs and completed media edits. Assistant prompt, inputText and outputText are limited to 4,000 characters each; hidden records exclude assistants.
notes.DELETE /api/external/history/{historyId}: Active records cannot be deleted. If file cleanup fails, the record is preserved.
notes.GET /api/external/models/{modelId}/schem: Send files as URLs, data URLs or multipart parts named file:parameterName.
notes.PATCH /api/external/admin/models/{modelK: The type and key cannot be changed.
notes.POST /api/external/admin/models/import: Review the returned draft, then save it with the model registration API.
notes.POST /api/external/admin/models/modal-co: Returns an inactive draft. Review it, then save it with the model registration API.
notes.GET /api/external/spaces/models: Returns active image, video, audio and LLM models. Use id to fetch the schema and key for modelKey in node configuration.
notes.GET /api/external/spaces/models/{modelId:
Put text and options at the node.config location given by x-node-config-path: prompt, parameters.FIELD or parameters.dynamicParams.FIELD.

Connect files using files.portId and the input asset.id. Run LLMs through generate.assistant nodes.
notes.PUT /api/external/spaces/{spaceId}:
Use space from the space response and an asset ID from the execution result. Set API_BASE_URL, API_KEY, SPACE_ID, NODE_ID and ASSET_ID in the example below.

Change the node’s selectedOutputAssetId and include its ID in selectionChanges when saving the complete graph. Select Assistant list items through the execution PATCH API.
notes.DELETE /api/external/spaces/{spaceId}: A space with an active execution cannot be deleted. Shared assets and history are preserved.
notes.POST /api/external/spaces/{spaceId}/node:
Poll the execution details using the returned executionId, then select a result after completion. Missing upstream results produce an input error.

Check apiExecutable and reason in capabilities for support. Resize is browser-only.
notes.GET /api/external/spaces/{spaceId}/nodes: Find media assets in outputAssetIds and outputBindings and select them through the graph save API. Select Assistant list items through the execution PATCH API. Execute the next node separately.
notes.DELETE /api/external/spaces/{spaceId}/no: Completed results are preserved. Remote provider interruption and refunds are not guaranteed.
notes.POST /api/external/assets/uploads:
1. Request an upload URL with this API.

2. PUT raw file bytes to upload.upload.url. Use the Content-Type from upload.upload.headers.

3. POST an empty object {} to the confirmation API and use the returned asset.id in a space input.
notes.PUT /api/external/assets/uploads/{upload: Keep target from the issued URL and send X-API-Key. Use the issued Content-Type and send raw file bytes in the body.
notes.POST /api/external/assets/uploads/{uploa: Send an empty object {}. Use the returned asset.id as the space’s file input.
notes.GET /api/external/history/{historyId}:
Returns prompts, input files and edit settings. Edits have no generation prompt; missing source details remain unknown. Playback duration uses asset metadata.

For type=assistant, use origin=generation. prompt, inputText and completed outputText are limited to 20,000 characters each; media arrays are empty.

queueMonitoring.title: Monitoring
queueMonitoring.description: Follow work through the service queue, execution and recovery.
queueMonitoring.searchHint: Job name, job ID, execution ID or model
queueMonitoring.periodHint: Current jobs have no default age limit. History defaults to 24 hours, up to 31 days. Times use this device’s time zone.
queueMonitoring.slotsHint: Running work and uncertain reservations are shown separately.
queueMonitoring.truncated: Only part of the resource or reservation list is shown. Use the job list to continue.
queueMonitoring.selectionPaused: Automatic list refresh is paused while a job is selected.
queueMonitoring.polling: Current jobs and summary refresh every 4 seconds.
queueMonitoring.emptyHint: The queue is empty or no jobs match the selected filters.
queueMonitoring.stale: Refresh failed. Showing the last successful sample.
queueMonitoring.invalidUrl: Some query conditions were invalid. Showing default filters.

errors.title: Unable to load
errors.auth: Sign in again with the configured administrator account.
errors.input: Check the query conditions. Date ranges and page sizes are limited.
errors.rate: Too many requests. Try again in {seconds} seconds.
errors.conflict: The state changed. Review the latest details before trying again.
errors.unavailable: Unable to reach the server. Please try again shortly.

queueMonitoring.detailHint: Inspect the original admission, current execution, attempts and administrator actions.
queueMonitoring.sourceMissing: The business source is missing. Showing retained queue records.
queueMonitoring.unknownTime: No admission timestamp can be established.
queueMonitoring.localFinishHint: A local finish timestamp does not establish remote termination.
queueMonitoring.allCyclesHint: Scroll down in each tab to review attempts and failures from every cycle.
queueMonitoring.imported: Imported from the previous system. These timestamps do not prove remote execution times.
queueMonitoring.actorOpaque: Individual administrator identities are omitted; use the server audit trail for attribution.
queueMonitoring.finalValidationNote: These checks describe current conditions. The server validates again when executing an action.
queueMonitoring.pendingOperation: The response was not confirmed. Check again using the same request.

impacts.redrive: Keep the original failure and admit another cycle. This may start paid generation. In collection mode, the existing remote result is collected.
impacts.reconcile: Read the stored Modal execution only. No new paid generation is submitted. Reservations are released only after remote termination is verified.
impacts.abandon: Record that this job is abandoned. This does not mark success, delete the job, establish remote termination, release reservations or advance ordered work.

outcomes.redrive_succeeded: Recovery was queued. It remains unresolved until execution succeeds.
outcomes.redrive_accepted: The recovery request was accepted. Check the latest job state.
outcomes.redrive_rejected: Current conditions do not allow recovery.
outcomes.reconcile_succeeded: Remote termination was verified and recorded. Review recovery if result collection is needed.
outcomes.reconcile_accepted: Verification was accepted. Reservations remain until termination is confirmed.
outcomes.reconcile_failed: The remote result could not be established. Uncertain reservations remain.
outcomes.reconcile_rejected: Current conditions do not allow remote verification.
outcomes.abandon_succeeded: Abandonment was recorded. Check retained reservations and ordered-work blockers.
outcomes.abandon_accepted: The request was accepted. Check the latest state.
outcomes.abandon_rejected: Current conditions do not allow abandonment.

queueMonitoring.reviewRequired: The latest state was loaded. Close this dialog and review the available actions again.
queueMonitoring.collectMode: The new cycle will collect an existing remote result instead of submitting new generation.
queueMonitoring.unknownReason: Additional server conditions need to be checked.
queueMonitoring.failedHint: Repeated failures are grouped into one job. Recovery admission is distinct from successful completion.
queueMonitoring.failedEmptyHint: Check the selected state and filters.

operationReasons.QUEUE_FINAL_VALIDATION_REQUIRED: Final validation is required when submitting.
operationReasons.QUEUE_DLQ_NOT_OPEN: This failure entry is no longer open.
operationReasons.QUEUE_JOB_NOT_FAILED: The job is not currently failed.
operationReasons.QUEUE_REMOTE_STOP_NOT_CONFIRMED: Remote termination or reservation release is not confirmed.
operationReasons.QUEUE_REDRIVE_SOURCE_CHANGED: The cleanup source state or revision changed.
operationReasons.QUEUE_REDRIVE_SOURCE_MISSING: The source is missing or is no longer failed.
operationReasons.QUEUE_REDRIVE_ASSET_PROTECTED: The asset is in use or protected.
operationReasons.QUEUE_REDRIVE_INPUT_MISSING: Required input assets or bindings are unavailable.
operationReasons.QUEUE_REDRIVE_TARGET_CHANGED: The target node kind or configuration changed.
operationReasons.QUEUE_REDRIVE_NODE_ACTIVE: Another execution is active on the node.
operationReasons.QUEUE_REDRIVE_CREDENTIAL_REVOKED: The required credential or API key is unavailable.
operationReasons.QUEUE_REDRIVE_SNAPSHOT_INVALID: The stored execution input cannot be validated.
operationReasons.QUEUE_REDRIVE_OWNER_LIMIT: The owner pending-work limit was reached.
operationReasons.QUEUE_REDRIVE_GLOBAL_LIMIT: The global pending-work limit was reached.
operationReasons.QUEUE_REDRIVE_PROVIDER_LIMIT: The model pending-work limit was reached.
operationReasons.QUEUE_RECONCILIATION_UNSUPPORTED: Stored Modal image/video verification is not supported for this job.
operationReasons.QUEUE_RECONCILIATION_BUSY: Remote verification is already in progress.
operationReasons.QUEUE_REMOTE_REFERENCE_MISSING: No durable remote execution reference is available.
operationReasons.QUEUE_REMOTE_STILL_UNCONFIRMED: Remote termination cannot yet be established.
operationReasons.PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE: The external processing service is unavailable.
operationReasons.MEDIA_CLEANUP_FAILED: The file could not be deleted from storage.

queueMonitoring.timelineHint: Compare actual attempt times and retained reservations. Bar length is elapsed time, not progress.
queueMonitoring.timelineLimit: Defaults to 5 minutes, up to 24 hours, with 50 attempts per page.
queueMonitoring.timelineEmptyHint: Choose another interval that overlaps execution or retained reservations.
queueMonitoring.clippedInterval: Parts of this interval fall outside the selected range and are clipped in the chart.
queueMonitoring.reservationTimingHint: Uncertain reflects the currently observed reservation state. Unrecorded state-transition and remote termination times are not inferred.
queueMonitoring.modelLimitsHint: Generation requires both a shared slot and a model slot. Uncertain reservations also consume capacity.
queueMonitoring.waitingAgeHint: Time since original admission, including blocked and delayed jobs.
queueMonitoring.queueDetails: Protection, model limits and server details
queueMonitoring.invalidIdentifier: The filter applies when a complete valid identifier is entered.
queueMonitoring.currentExecutionResult: This is the current redrive execution. The original request ID is listed separately below.
queueMonitoring.resultMissing: The linked request is missing or its detailed result is no longer retained.
queueMonitoring.resultError: Could not load the request result. Check access and retention, or try again.
queueMonitoring.resultPreviewHint: View full request information in the General tab.
